comment: I loved the stories Dr. De Sa would share about his field work. It's clear that he cares about making sure students have a good grasp of the material. He was a little disorganized at times, but definitely passionate about what he teaches. *He was very accommodating and eased up on the workload when we made the switch to remote learning.

Dr de Sa was the best teacher I had at Richmond. The most compassionate, and enthusiastic who genuinely is fascinated by his work and encourages you to find the same fascination. My time in the biology department was definite by my working with Dr deSa. And I even chose to do research with him. I cannot recommend him highly enough.

He is a gem in an otherwise largely not inspirational biology department. This is the first biology class in which I've felt extremely challenged but came away feeling like I still learned a TON. Course content is interesting and fun. The semester is full-on, but you will be a better person after taking this class. Dr. De Sa is the absolute best!

Dr. De Sa has always shown a genuine interest in his students' well-being and class performance. He is not easy, and expects a high level of commitment. I would not recommend for anyone who is filling a requirement. Avoid taking him at 8:15 because his heavy accent can be rough in the morning.

worst teacher ever! i don't know what these other people are talking about, but this guy is horrible! He thinks non-majors are retarded and treats you like it.  he begs you to ask questions and gets mad when you don't but when you do he acts like you weren't paying attention and must just be dumb.
Very fun, a genuinely nice guy. His accent/lisp/occasional stutter are sometimes an issue and his tests are hard, but it is easy to make up the points through labs and projects.  A great guy.
he really cares about his students and is always willing to help.  his courses are tough though!
